name: deepep_permute
description: deepep_permute(input, gateup_input, src2dst, topk_ids, topk, hidden_size) -> out. input is [num_tokens, hidden] and gateup_input is [num_tokens*topk, hidden]; src2dst is an integer [num_tokens, topk] destination table. For each flat slot in row-major repeat_interleave order, if dst = src2dst[row, slot] is non-negative, copy input[row] to gateup_input[dst]; negative slots are skipped. topk_ids is accepted for ABI compatibility but is not used by the permutation. The native path writes into a contiguous gateup_input and returns it; when gateup_input is already contiguous the returned out aliases and mutates it, otherwise the op writes a contiguous copy and returns that copy. input is read-only. The exercised cases use bf16 and hidden sizes including 2048, 4096, and 7168.
